title: Book One · Chapter 166: The Papers behind the Pictures
story:
Miss Wu asks for the permission papers. She wants to check them all together. Ronan has kept them in a thin cover. He brings it to her desk. There are notes from people in the pictures. Another page is a list of loans. The current room plan is there too.

The teacher spreads them out. She is not asking for new stories. She reads each name beside its picture or object. The names and objects must match. She checks them before anything goes up.

They begin with Mr Qiu. Mr Qiu has agreed to the table picture. The short story is about the books and the dry place. His payment to Mrs Lan is private. That is not in the story. He is lending the pencil box and writing pad. The children must give both back after the afternoon.

Mei brings her own page. Her mother has seen the pictures. Mei has chosen three pictures herself. She wants to show these three. Visitors may look at them. They can ask Mei questions too. They must not take the sheets down. They must not add their own drawings to them.

“What if she wants to take one home early?” Ronan asks.

“Then we talk and take it down carefully,” Miss Wu says. “It is still hers.”

Ronan nods. He remembers the white space on the old classroom wall. Mei may take a picture home this time too. There would be an empty space on the wall. People could still enjoy the other pictures.

Mum's card has her own written name and her cloth mark. There will be three light books inside the bag. Visitors may lift it gently with clean hands. Her name is not replaced by RONAN'S MUM. Ronan checks Mum's name twice. He knows that matters to her.

Dad's paper is short. They may show the stool. People may sit on it while an adult watches. It is a normal, safe seat. The card says it was loose and Dad repaired it. The old shop story is not on the list. The old-home drawing will stay at home too.

Miss Wu leaves those two papers off the list. She does not ask Ronan to bring them. She ticks the stool on the list. Then she puts the paper back.

The food-shop picture has its own note. Mrs Lan said yes to the map. They may show her green gate there. The room does not show the inside of her home. There is a blank door in Leo's game. It asks a question the children cannot answer yet. Visitors may tell them about the blank door. They will write a name beside each answer. They must check each answer first. Then they can decide: Is this answer true?

By the end Ronan is tired of reading his own list. He looks at the window. He wants to go outside and play. Miss Wu closes the cover and gives it back.

“One place for these,” she says. “Then you can find a paper when you need it. You can spend the rest of the time with visitors.”

He puts the cover in the bag pocket. Leo is waiting with the ball. Lessons have not started again yet. They have time for a short game.

At first, Ronan is still thinking about the papers. He does not watch Leo and runs badly. Leo catches him at the line and grins. The next time Ronan watches the open ground instead. He turns and gets past.

Later he washes his hands and thinks about the papers. Each person said yes to some things. He has written all those answers down. He has not put any private stories in it. He can open the cover in front of visitors. He can leave the papers in their cover on Saturday. Then he can talk to visitors and enjoy the work.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：match＝相对应；agreed＝同意了；take … home＝带回家。

情节提示：permission papers＝记录许可的纸；tick＝对勾；private＝不公开的。

理解：1. 许可材料为什么统一放在一个夹子里？2. 来访者给灰门提供的答案将怎样记录？
